svg.title: One statement: two searches fused by reciprocal rank, then a hop to each topic's latest decision
svg.desc: A question runs a vector SEARCH over the embeddings and a full-text SEARCH over the text, each returning its top k notes. Reciprocal rank fusion merges the two lists, scoring each note by the sum of 1 / (60 + rank). The top notes then hop ABOUT to their topics, and each topic's latest DECIDED gives the current decision.
